name: Pocky
about: Thin biscuit sticks dipped in chocolate, with a bare end to hold so your fingers stay clean.

name: Onigiri
about: A rice ball wrapped in nori, with a filling in the middle: salmon, tuna mayo or pickled plum.

name: Melon Pan
about: A soft sweet bun under a crisp cookie crust, scored to look like a melon. Usually no melon in it.

name: Mochi
about: Chewy pounded rice cake, often filled with sweet red bean paste.

name: Taiyaki
about: A fish-shaped waffle cake filled with red bean, custard or chocolate, best eaten warm.

name: Ramune
about: A fizzy lemonade sealed with a glass marble. Push the marble down to open it.
